text: What Isaac knows is never told. He carries the wood; he asks about the lamb; and the answer his father gives him leaves the question where it was. Of his mind the narrator offers nothing, only a verb: they went, both of them, together. The phrase recurs, and the repetition is made to serve in place of an explanation. The question of his consent is raised and then laid aside unresolved, for in this account obedience settles everything and leaves nothing over.
